rationale: Price is at 96.7% of today's range and within 0.25% of the session high after an 8.86% gap-up, with the 1-minute candles showing tight consolidation just below the high — momentum is stalling rather than breaking out. The news is fundamentally negative (massive goodwill charge, shrinking margins, transformation costs excluded from adjusted earnings), meaning the gap reflects a relief/beat reaction that may be exhausted near the high. With 115 minutes to close and price already extended well above VWAP ($57.45), the risk/reward for both a long (chasing near the high with negative fundamentals) and a short (fighting residual gap momentum) is unfavorable.
